environment.description: Service runs on EKS in private subnet (10.128.0.0/17). Traffic ingress via internal NLB (scheme: internal) with target group health check on /health. Upstream connectivity governed by VPC security group sg-0a4f8e2c1b (inbound rule: TCP/443 from sg-0b7d3a9e5f only, which is attached to the corp VPN gateway ENIs in 10.200.0.0/24). Additionally, a Cilium L4 NetworkPolicy (cnp-reporting-ingress) on the namespace restricts pod ingress to CIDR 10.200.0.0/24 and 10.128.64.0/20 (internal service mesh sidecar range). DNS resolution for the NLB is only available via Route53 private hosted zone (corp.internal) associated with the VPC. No public DNS record exists. The EKS cluster has no public endpoint enabled (api-server-endpoint: private). Pod service account has no IAM role for external network calls.
